steps.en: OCMS checks the latest registered address of the furnished person
steps.id: OCMS mengecek registered address terbaru orang yang di-furnish
steps.why_en: Only personal ID holders are looked up; companies and foreigners are not covered in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Hanya pemegang NRIC yang dicari; perusahaan dan orang asing tidak tercakup di pengaturan production.

steps.en: OCMS confirms the registered and furnished addresses match
steps.id: OCMS memastikan alamat terdaftar cocok dengan alamat furnish
steps.why_en: No code compares the two addresses.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang membandingkan kedua alamat.

steps.en: OCMS updates the address as needed
steps.why_en: The registered address is saved whether or not it matches, and later letters switch to it automatically.
steps.why_id: Alamat terdaftar disimpan entah cocok atau tidak, dan surat berikutnya otomatis beralih ke alamat itu.

steps.en: The updated notice shows up in the online payment portal
steps.id: Notice yang diperbarui muncul di portal pembayaran online
steps.why_en: Notice data syncs every ten minutes, but address details are not copied and past gaps hid some notices.
steps.why_id: Data notice disinkron tiap sepuluh menit, tetapi detail alamat tidak disalin dan celah sebelumnya sempat menyembunyikan sebagian notice.

steps.en: Follow-up letters go to the furnished person per the workflow
steps.id: Surat tindak lanjut dikirim ke orang yang di-furnish sesuai workflow
steps.why_en: Letters are only produced by a manual trigger and the upload to the printer is switched off in the settings.
steps.why_id: Surat hanya dibuat lewat pemicu manual dan upload ke percetakan dimatikan di pengaturan.
